note.zh-TW: 現金流量表模板的「銷貨債權」直譯自日文，原意包含應收票據與應收帳款；本課沒有應收票據，所以它就是應收帳款的變動。IAS 1 的報表大項名稱是應收帳款及其他應收款（trade and other receivables）。
note.en: The template cash flow line uses a Japanese-style name (literally ‘sales receivables’) that originally covers both notes and accounts receivable; the course has no notes receivable, so it is simply the movement in this account. The IAS 1 line item is trade and other receivables.

definition.zh-TW: 賒銷之後客戶還沒付的貨款。它是流動資產，收到錢時減少；賒銷當下收入已經認列，所以應收帳款增加表示有收入還沒變成現金。
definition.en: Amounts customers still owe for goods sold on credit. It is a current asset that falls when the customer pays; revenue is recognised at the sale, so a rise in receivables means some revenue has not yet turned into cash.
